reasons.plausibility: HIP at 1000°C is above the melting point of Cu (1085°C) and would melt the matrix, making the proposed mechanism of solid-state diffusion and void closure invalid.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-structured, but the fundamental physical impossibility of the treatment renders the test moot.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a treatment condition that would destroy the composite, failing to address the core challenge of the research question.
